en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I might fall asleep...
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

In that case, would you like to receive 
a lecture instead of watching a movie?
Very well...

Perhaps we shall dig deeper into the 
tale of Hainuwele I told you before.

Kehehe...
Worry not. I shall never bore you.
I cannot admire such a suggestion...

Those interested in such banal activities 
are ill-suited as seekers of culture.

I thought you had the qualities of an 
anthropologist, but I was mistaken...

Kehehe... I have been waiting 
to hear such words.

Anthropology is all about field work...
Investigating in person is critical.

References are important, but one's
own experience is far more so.

I am glad you are coming to 
understand anthropology so well.

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Korekiyo's inner thoughts...?
